content:
Maya Chen: Quick check — who can take the 14:00 release slot today? small user-service and auth-service patches.
Jae Park: I can own the slot. planning a canary -> full rollout.
Priya Rao: I can own smoke for user-service + auth-service. will run the quick regression set.
Omar Diaz: FYI there is a tiny DB migration in the bundle (adds index). schedule it after canary, please. need a 20m rollback window.
Alex Nguyen: Code review for the infra tweak just merged (PR #4321). bumped retry backoff. no schema changes except the migration Omar mentioned.
Jae Park: thanks Alex. I pushed a deploy script. will queue at :00 and promote at :10 if canary looks good.
Jae Park: deploy command I'm running:
```
./deploy --env=prod --service=user-service,auth-service --tag=release-2026-03-14 --canary=5% --step=10m
```
Priya Rao: Smoke checklist (short):
- auth login flow x3
- signup happy path x1
- session persistence check
- latency < 150ms on token endpoints
I'll paste results here as I run.
Maya Chen: Who do we ping on rollback? oncall is this slot? @Omar Diaz?
Omar Diaz: Yep I can take rollback. I'll be watching metrics and DB tasks. if anything looks off, I'll execute rollback steps (docs link below).
Alex Nguyen: Quick note: if canary fails, deploy-bot should stop and notify.
deploy-bot: :rocket: Deployment queued by Jae Park for services: user-service, auth-service. Canary target: 5%. Rollback timeout: 20m. Run ID: run-2026-1799999001.
Priya Rao: Canary started — running smoke suite now. auth login x3 -> OK, signup -> OK, token latency 120ms median. No errors in logs so far. :thumbsup:
Jae Park: Promoting to broader traffic at :10. keeping an eye on error rate and DB lock metrics.
Maya Chen: Reminder: please comment the final status on the release ticket and add the post-deploy tag.
Omar Diaz: DB migration applied at +6m in canary cohort. No long locks observed.
Priya Rao: Post-canary results: all checks green. increasing traffic to 50% then 100%.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary success. Promoting to 100% traffic now.
Jae Park: Completed. Monitoring for 15m then closing the slot. Thanks all. :rocket:
Maya Chen: Great work — I'll mark the train as complete and add notes about the migration.
Priya Rao: Leaving final smoke logs in the ticket.
Omar Diaz: Rollback window expired clean. DB migration verified.
Alex Nguyen: tagging infra for follow-up on retry metrics but nothing urgent.
Maya Chen: OK closing out. If anyone spots anything odd ping here first. :eyes:
